observations: Photo 0 shows a black DSLR camera with a lens attached, placed on bubble wrap. The camera has a top LCD screen, mode dial, and various buttons. A Canon battery and charger are visible in front. The lens has 'Tamron' branding and '24-70mm' visible.
The camera body appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and dust. The lens shows signs of use, including possible smudges or residue.
The charger and battery are labeled 'Canon' and appear to be standard AA-style batteries with a charger, but no model number is visible.
No power cord or battery compartment is visible in any photo.
The background includes a box with 'Canon' and 'Tamron' branding, suggesting the lens is genuine, but no proof of camera model is visible.
